name: Gentamicin creatinine-clearance PK reference curve (Duong 2022 / Bos 2019), stochastic
kind: literature-model-derived, with published residual error applied
statement: Reference points are the predictions of the published Duong 2022 (Bos 2019 structural) one-compartment gentamicin population PK model at the published cohort descriptors, PLUS residual error drawn from that model's published combined additive-plus-proportional error model. They are NOT raw patient observations. Because the fit target now carries realistic residual noise, the optimum is a noisy-data estimate rather than exact parameter recovery.

noise_model.form: y_obs = y_pred + SD * z,  SD = sqrt((prop * y_pred)^2 + add^2),  z ~ N(0,1)
noise_model.citation: Bos JC et al. Antimicrob Agents Chemother 2019;63(4):e02328-18, Table S1 (Proportional 32%, Additive 0.056 mg/L), carried forward by Duong A et al. Pharmaceutics 2022;14(7):1426 for the Bos structural model.
noise_model.seed_location: Host-side holdout provenance.json. The seed is deliberately NOT stored in this repository: with the seed and this error model the noise-free curve could be reconstructed exactly, which would defeat the benchmark.

noise_free_holdout.role: External check ONLY. Never read by evaluator/judge.mjs, never used for fitting, and located outside the Git repository so it is outside the autoresearch worktree.
noise_free_holdout.location: Host-side holdout directory; deliberately not recorded in this repository.
noise_free_holdout.contains: reference_points_noiseless.csv, generate_reference_data.mjs (seed + error model + true values), provenance.json, monte_carlo.mjs, external_check.mjs, compare_objectives.mjs, LEDGER.md
noise_free_holdout.identified_by: sha256 of the noise-free CSV, so the exact file can be audited without being disclosed

sources.role: structural model, cohort descriptors (Table 1), and the parameter values held in the Host-side holdout
sources.citation: Duong A, Simard C, Williamson D, Marsot A. Model Re-Estimation: An Alternative for Poor Predictive Performance during External Evaluations? Example of Gentamicin in Critically Ill Patients. Pharmaceutics 2022;14(7):1426.

Bos JC, Prins JM, Misticio MC, Nunguiane G, Lang CN, Beirao JC, Mathot RAA, van Hest RM. Population pharmacokinetics with Monte Carlo simulations of gentamicin in a population of severely ill adult patients from sub-Saharan Africa. Antimicrob Agents Chemother 2019;63(4):e02328-18.

external_validation.role: Independent literature consistency check ONLY. Not read by evaluator/judge.mjs and not part of the metric.
external_validation.citation: Veinstein A, Venisse N, Badin J, Pinsard M, Robert R, Dupuis A. Gentamicin in hemodialyzed critical care patients: early dialysis after administration of a high dose should be considered. Antimicrob Agents Chemother 2013;57(2):977-982.
external_validation.note: Anuric/near-anuric ICU patients on intermittent haemodialysis; CrCl is not reported, so this cohort cannot constrain the CrCl slope. It corroborates the model's implied non-renal clearance: extrapolating the published relation to CrCl = 0 gives 0.513 L/h = 8.5 mL/min, against the independently published population estimate CL_NHD = 0.1205 mL/min/kg (Table 4) = 9.1 mL/min at the cohort mean weight of 75.6 kg.
external_validation.transcription_check: Eight of nine summary columns reproduce the paper's printed Mean +/- SD exactly. CL_HD does not: the ten printed per-patient values give 74.72 +/- 23.57 mL/min against a printed 76.5 +/- 23.1, an inconsistency in the source. CL_HD is not used by any check.

cohort.description: Critically ill adult ICU patients (Quebec, Canada): HSCM n=39 and IUCPQ n=48.
